meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 把 224x224 的 H&E 组织切片图转成空间基因表达值(log1p-CPM),每个 tile 每个基因一个数值。可按基因符号查询约 1.9 万个蛋白编码基因,也能对整张切片批量预测。
howto.when: 当你需要 224x224、约 20x 的 H&E tile 的空间基因表达,想按基因符号查蛋白编码基因,或对用 histolab 切好的整张切片做预测时使用。

say.text: 预测这张 224x224 H&E tile 中 EPCAM、CD3D 的表达
say.note: 返回 log1p-CPM 值,顺序与基因列表一致

say.text: 换 source=evo2 重跑同一批 tile
say.note: 用另一种基因嵌入再算一遍,便于对比

say.text: 把 histolab 切好的整张切片批量预测,拼成 tiles×genes 矩阵
say.note: 输出可加坐标并放入 AnnData

howto.what_en: Turns a 224x224 H&E tile into spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM: one value per queried gene per tile, queryable by HGNC symbol across a ~19k protein-coding panel, or batched across a whole slide.
howto.when_en: Use when you need 224x224 (~20x) H&E tiles mapped to log1p-CPM expression, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or run a whole slide tiled with histolab.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D for this 224x224 H&E tile
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values aligned to your gene list

say_en.text: Re-run the same tiles with source=evo2
say_en.note: Uses a different gene embedding for comparison

say_en.text: Batch-predict a histolab-tiled slide into a tiles-by-genes matrix
say_en.note: Add coordinates; the matrix drops into AnnData
